applies_to: Guidewire PolicyCenter 10.x / Guidewire Cloud / earlier on-premise
info_to_collect: Policy, term, audit job number and audit type (final, interim, revision, non-compliant)
Each GL exposure: class code, location/state, basis type (payroll, sales, area, units), estimated and audited basis
Whether Products-Completed Operations applies; limits (each occurrence / aggregate)
Expected premium and direction vs premium shown
Mid-term changes (class added/removed, location or limit change) and dates; keyed by auditor or automation; screenshots
title: Null premium error on GL cancellation or after removing a location or exposure
symptoms: 'Null premium' error at quote or bind of a GL cancellation or policy change
Billing-initiated cancellation does not process in PolicyCenter
Error after removing a GL location or exposure
cause: A GL cost row or its amount is null - typically a cost orphaned when an exposure or location is removed, or the cancellation pro-rata hitting a slice with no rated cost. Historical tickets name vehicles; the GL equivalent is inferred.
diagnosis: Capture error text and time; find the trace in logs
Identify the exposure, slice and cost with a null amount
Check whether permanent fix T0271 covers GL exposures and locations
resolution: L3 removes the orphan GL cost (scripted data fix) and re-quotes
workaround: Cancel from the next date that has rated costs, with UW approval.
permanent_fix: Null-safe cost calculation per exposure; pre-bind guard; log alert. Reopen the Problem if it recurs after T0271.
